title: OAuth Client Secret reachable in historical git commits
evidence: OPEN_ISSUES.md:25; canonical ledger SEC-001. OAuth client JSON was removed from current tree and added to .gitignore, but commit history contains live-shaped client secrets.
impact: Potential compromise of GCP OAuth application credentials if git repository is leaked or accessed by untrusted third parties.
rootCause: Credential file checked in during initial prototype phase without pre-commit secret scanning hooks.
recommendedCorrection: Rotate OAuth Client Secret immediately in Google Cloud Console. Purge the historical commit or rebase repository using git-filter-repo.
verification: GCP Console audit shows revoked secret; git log grep confirms no references in revised history.
status: Partially Mitigated (Ignored in tree, pending GCP rotation)

title: Computer Execution per-action approval enforcement is unwired
evidence: packages/main/src/handlers/computer.ts:218-221; packages/main/src/services/ComputerExecutionService.ts:40-47. Session grant primitives (create/check/revoke) are implemented and tested, but are not invoked prior to executing computer:click, computer:type, or computer:key.
impact: A compromised remote session or prompt-injected agent could issue OS-level clicks and keystrokes without user interactive confirmation.
rootCause: Grant system was designed as a reusable primitive (ISSUE-1114) but intentionally deferred per-action dispatch wiring pending unified platform approval architecture (ISSUE-1116).
recommendedCorrection: Wire hasActiveGrant check into computer:click, computer:type, computer:key, and computer:scroll in handlers/computer.ts before invoking ComputerExecutionService.
verification: Unit test verifying computer:click rejects with UNAUTHORIZED_SESSION when no valid grant is active.

title: Desktop Python runtime and NumPy dependencies are unbundled in packaged app
affectedUserJourney: Prepare & Deliver (Local Audio Analysis & DDEX Ingestion)
evidence: packages/main/src/utils/python-bridge.ts:7-20; electron-builder.json:14-22; execution/audio/audio_analysis.py:94-115. electron-builder bundles execution/ scripts into extraResources, but relies on host system python3. If host python lacks numpy, audio_analysis.py raises RuntimeError.
impact: Artists on clean macOS/Windows machines without developer tools experience silent failures or exceptions when running advanced audio analysis or local packaging.
rootCause: Monorepo assumed system python3 with scientific libraries would be present in user environment.
recommendedCorrection: Either bundle a standalone standalone Python embedded distribution (e.g. PyInstaller binary or python-standalone) or migrate audio_analysis.py technical feature extraction to native FFprobe / C++ addon / WebAssembly (Essentia.js) which already runs standalone.
verification: Run packaged app on a pristine virtual machine without Python installed; verify audio analysis succeeds.

title: Studio Executor lifecycle is tied to mounted React UI in Renderer
evidence: packages/renderer/src/core/App.tsx:146-151; packages/renderer/src/hooks/useRemoteCommandListener.ts:60-74; packages/renderer/src/services/remote/StudioExecutorCore.ts:1-20. StudioExecutorCore is mounted via a React hook in StudioApplication. If the renderer crashes or is reloaded, the executor stops until React remounts.
impact: Remote commands received while the renderer is reloading or if the renderer encounters a fatal React error cannot be claimed or answered.
rootCause: Phase 2/3 of REMOTE_EXECUTOR_CORE_PLAN extracted StudioExecutorCore as framework-free, but Phase 6-9 (moving Core to Electron utilityProcess / Main process) was deferred.
recommendedCorrection: Execute Phase 6 of REMOTE_EXECUTOR_CORE_PLAN: instantiate StudioExecutorCore in Electron Main process or an isolated utilityProcess so it survives renderer crashes and reloads.
verification: Trigger a hard renderer reload (Cmd+R); verify remote ping command is claimed and replied to immediately without delay.

title: Founder music-identity & royalty registration prerequisites not connected to release gates
evidence: OPEN_ISSUES_V3.md:20-42 (ISSUE-1121); packages/renderer/src/modules/registration/RegistrationCenter.tsx:16-63. Registration Center tracks per-track submissions, but lacks an organization-level prerequisite ledger for US ISRC Rights Owner prefix, GS1 GTIN/UPC company prefix, DPID, and PRO publisher affiliation.
impact: Artists may generate local ISRCs or UPCs that are not officially recognized by GS1 or the US ISRC Agency, leading to rejection during commercial DDEX distribution.
rootCause: Track-level metadata generation was developed before organization-level legal entity validation.
recommendedCorrection: Add Organization Founder Readiness record to the release gate checklist. Require verified owner prefix before issuing production DDEX XML.
verification: Attempt to submit release with unverified prefix; verify distribution pipeline halts with actionable prerequisite instructions.

title: Public subscription pricing ($22/$55/$110) unaligned with backend Stripe products and entitlement keys
evidence: OPEN_ISSUES_V3.md:2875-2885 (ISSUE-1422); packages/firebase/src/stripe/config.ts; packages/firebase/src/stripe/webhookHandler.ts:11-13. Marketing decisions approved $22/$55/$110 tiers, but internal config references legacy tier names and price mappings.
impact: Risk of selling subscriptions under deprecated price IDs or delivering incorrect quota/entitlements upon webhook receipt.
rootCause: Marketing pricing update occurred without synchronized Stripe product provisioning and schema migration in Cloud Functions.
recommendedCorrection: Provision new Price IDs in Stripe Dashboard; update packages/firebase/src/stripe/config.ts and shared subscription schemas; test checkout lifecycle end-to-end.
verification: Complete test checkout on Stripe sandbox; verify Firestore subscriptions/{uid} correctly reflects new tier and limits.

title: Hidden-bug baseline risk score is 118 with ~560 unprotected awaits and 26 direct Firebase imports
evidence: scripts/detect-hidden-bugs.sh output; OPEN_ISSUES_V3.md:754-780 (ISSUE-1227). Scanner detects 65 base64 usages, 47 httpsCallable uses, ~560 unprotected awaits, 26 direct Firebase imports, and 10 unhandled promise rejections.
impact: Unexpected runtime exceptions in network-constrained environments or during transient Firebase outages can cause unhandled promise rejections and silent UI hangs.
rootCause: Rapid feature iteration in creative and touring modules bypassed centralized service abstraction and try/catch wrappers.
recommendedCorrection: Triage top httpsCallable call sites in creative and touring modules to route through resilient service layers with error boundaries and fallback handlers.
verification: Run bash scripts/detect-hidden-bugs.sh; verify risk score drops below 100.

title: Orphaned Prodigi credential fields remain in UI after provider retirement
evidence: HANDOFF_STATE.md:120; packages/renderer/src/modules/merchandise/components/PODIntegrationPanel.tsx. Phantom ProdigiProvider was deleted in commit f5116c6ff (ISSUE-1417), but credential input panel still accepts keys for a nonexistent provider.
impact: Artist confusion: users can enter credentials for Prodigi which will never be invoked.
rootCause: UI clean-up was split from backend provider removal.
recommendedCorrection: Remove Prodigi input fields from PODIntegrationPanel.tsx or gate behind feature flag until Prodigi backend is developed.
verification: Merchandise Settings renders only active providers (Printful).

title: Homepage lifecycle timeline uses UI placeholders instead of verified product captures
evidence: OPEN_ISSUES_V3.md:2919-2940 (ISSUE-1426, ISSUE-1427); packages/landing/src/. Real product video clips with accessible synchronized captions are missing across the 8 lifecycle stages.
impact: Potential artists cannot inspect genuine software workflows before joining waitlist or creating an account.
rootCause: Landing page UI structure was built before demo video assets were finalized.
recommendedCorrection: Record and caption eight 15-30s product demo clips showing genuine Studio workflows; embed in Landing lifecycle tabs.
verification: Inspect landing page on desktop and mobile; verify all 8 video clips play with accurate captions and zero layout shift.

title: Verified security architecture for Remote Relay, Keychain leases, and Firestore Rules
evidence: packages/renderer/src/services/remote/StudioExecutorCore.ts; packages/firebase/src/functions/remote/issueStudioExecutorLease.ts; packages/firebase/firestore.rules:805-855; packages/main/src/security/AccessControlService.ts. Architecture enforces: OS keychain hardware leases, fail-closed Firestore rules, realpath canonicalization, and strict sender validation on all IPC channels.
impact: Confirms system exhibits high defensive engineering in its core security foundations.
rootCause: Targeted architectural remediation executed across recent hardening sprints.
recommendedCorrection: Preserve established security and lease architecture during future refactors.
verification: npm run test:rules (133/133 pass); npm run lint (0 errors); npm run typecheck (0 errors).
